title: Minimal chunked render starter
blurb: The smallest pull loop: startRendering(4096) until a finite context closes itself, plus a length: null context stopped with close().
question: What is the minimum code to render a finite graph in bounded chunks, and to render and stop an indefinite-length context?
result: A 96,000-frame stereo context came back as 23 chunks of 4096 frames plus 1,792 and closed itself; a length: null context reported length === null, rendered 12 × 4096 frames and closed on close().
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 (Linux, headless, no flags) on 2026-11-27
